configuration.authentication: Host-specific native Sign in with ChatGPT; explicit plan-use consent

release_blockers: Exact source, dependency versions and clean main revisions retained
Local backend/frontend/infrastructure checks and actual SQL upgrade/dispatch guards pass
Actual OpenClaw CLI structured transport matches the recorded model decision
All declared live answer cases pass typed and substantive review for the final candidate
Host-specific legitimate ChatGPT consent, refresh, model availability and a real inference request pass without an API key
Every request/response/failure and available usage is privately retained with retrieval hash verification
Deployed API/controller sources match their pinned manifest and use OpenClaw without Bedrock/API fallback
Budget, deadline, concurrency, fenced leases, unknown outcomes and quota pauses remain enforced
Public pages and mobile/desktop themes, navigation, missing-data states and sign-in return paths pass
Authenticated production request persists its exact prompt and outcome when a legitimate Google session is available

live_evaluation.criteria: Every answer must satisfy the actual typed controller schema, permitted phase, source/identifier coverage and scientific scope. Inspect raw and rendered answers. Preserve failures; amended/reused cases become development evidence. Do not tune an outcome or call AI review human/independent review.

resources.idle_host_costs: Retain unallocated ongoing compute/storage separately; missing allocation is not zero.

conditional_checks: Independent human scientific review is unavailable
No new Internet or physical networking measurement is inferred from archived arithmetic
Invoice-level subscription and infrastructure charges may be unavailable
A legitimate user may need to complete host-specific ChatGPT consent and Google sign-in; credentials cannot be fabricated or copied between agent hosts
amendments: Preserve this protocol and failed evaluations; record changed criteria/configurations before dependent follow-ups.
